invariants: Never serialize null as zero for ITS, fire count, physical incident or real feedback
Only active forecast model versions power_phase_scada_v2 and pump_scada_v1 may enter forecast drafts
Observed drafts have score null; model scores do not imply physical failure probability or common urgency
Every draft_id is independently reviewable even when several drafts share group_id
Historical results are read-only; real decisions are a separate append-only server resource
A regular conflicting decision returns 409; privileged correction is a new audited event, never an update in place
Work orders are created only after explicit human action and an approved draft; IDs are owned by backend, optional external IDs are mappings
Do not expose retrospective target outcomes in as-of or replay views
Unknown or uncatalogued channels remain visible, with reasons
